summary: Keep generated pool Corosync node IDs within knet's supported range

guide.reason: This corrects native cluster configuration generation without changing an operator workflow.

api.reason: The host's internal Corosync node-ID derivation changes; no Controller/Core or client API field or operation changes.

roadmap.reason: The bug fix leaves the witness and hardware acceptance gates open.

state.reason: The Core pool membership remains the source of host IDs; Core derives and writes its local Corosync configuration. Controller does not retain node IDs.
state.record: Core pool membership host IDs and Core-rendered /etc/corosync/corosync.conf; a fresh Controller reads the same pool identity from Core inventory.

verification.method: A focused vmhost regression failed before the fix for a derived 31-bit node ID and passed afterward. A native Debian 13 parser rejected the old output; a temporary candidate two-host output with corrected IDs passed corosync -t -c in an ephemeral container. The witness renderer was removed pending a connected Core path. No qdevice session or cluster recovery was exercised.
